summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/operations/backups/[backupId]/restore POST route now rejects signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before backup restore writes can run.

redGreenEvidence.observed: The unsafe backup restore actorId case failed with HTTP 500 because the validly signed unsafe actorId reached later ownership lookup. The unsafe backup restore sessionId case failed with HTTP 200 because the validly signed unsafe sessionId allowed a local backup restore write.

redGreenEvidence.command: ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed backup restore|lets the owning teacher restore a local teaching operation backup"

behaviorHardened: Signed backup restore cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed backup restore cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed identity claims are rejected before local backup restore writes or teaching-operations-backup.restored audit events can be written.
The denial response preserves trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.
